conventions.scenario_frame: LDraw LDU per scenario: -Y up, the scenario front faces -Z (towards the catalog camera), ground (top of the base) at y = 0. Each control's default 0 is the built pose.
conventions.rules: Every clip starts at rest (all controls 0) and ends at rest; periodic channels may end on whole turns (an identical pose). Values stay inside the control ranges.

styles.ease_cycle: Open, hold, close with sine ease-in/out; starts and ends at rest with zero speed (loops cleanly)
styles.slam_bounce: Fast close into a stop with Blender's BOUNCE ease-out: accelerates, hits, rebounds twice, settles
styles.hesitant: Small stepped openings with pauses (a creaking or cautious opening)
styles.mirrored_pair: Two elements move together with identical values (mirrored by their axes)
styles.staggered_pair: Two elements move one after the other, overlapping in time
styles.damped_swing: Released element swings through its rest position with decaying sine half-cycles
styles.flutter: Small irregular oscillations about a partly open position (wind)
styles.peek: Partial opening (a crack), hold, close; repeated or single
styles.gravity_drop: Falls open under gravity: QUAD ease-in or BOUNCE ease-out onto a stop
styles.winch_linear: Constant-speed (LINEAR) movement, like a winch or motor
styles.overshoot_settle: Moves past the target and settles back with Blender's BACK ease-out (gas strut, spring)
styles.stepped: Equal steps with holds (chain hoist, ratchet, hydraulic stages)
styles.continuous_spin: Constant angular speed over whole turns (loops cleanly)
styles.spin_up_down: Accelerates (QUAD in), cruises (LINEAR), decelerates (QUAD out) to a whole number of turns
styles.sweep: Back-and-forth sine oscillation about the rest position (scanning)
styles.slide_bounce: Slides into an end stop with a BOUNCE ease-out
styles.sequence: Several channels in a scripted order (open, use, close)
styles.shake: Fast small oscillation around a held pose (shaking out a load)
styles.toggle: Snap between positions with very short QUAD moves and holds

clips.title: Open and close
clips.description: The door swings open to about 92 deg, waits, and closes.

clips.title: Slam shut
clips.description: Opens calmly, then is let go: it slams shut and bounces twice off the frame.

clips.title: Creaking open
clips.description: Opens in small hesitant pushes with pauses, then swings shut.

clips.title: Open both panes
clips.description: Both panes open together toward the viewer, wait, and close.

clips.title: One pane after the other
clips.description: Left pane opens, then the right; they close in reverse order.

clips.title: Wind flutter
clips.description: Both panes stand ajar and flutter in gusts, then are pulled shut.

clips.title: Fold open
clips.description: Both shutters fold all the way back against the wall and close again.

clips.title: One at a time
clips.description: Left shutter opens, then the right; left closes first.

clips.title: Storm banging
clips.description: Unlatched shutters are blown open and bang shut again and again.

clips.title: Push through and swing back
clips.description: Pushed open outward, released: the gate swings back through closed and oscillates to rest.

clips.title: Open and latch
clips.description: Opens outward, waits, swings shut and rattles on the latch.

clips.title: Inward then outward
clips.description: Opens outward and closes, then opens inward and closes.

clips.title: Door open and close
clips.description: The lower cupboard door opens wide, waits, and closes.

clips.title: Drawers pulled and pushed
clips.description: Top drawer pulled out and pushed back so it bumps on its stop; then the lower drawer.

clips.title: Fetch something
clips.description: Door opens, top drawer slides out and back, door closes.

clips.title: Open both doors
clips.description: Both doors open together, wait, and close.

clips.title: Left then right
clips.description: Left door opens, then the right; right closes first.

clips.title: Peek inside
clips.description: The right door opens a crack twice; then the left door opens halfway and closes.

clips.title: Slow reveal
clips.description: The lid rises slowly and smoothly to fully open, waits, and closes.

clips.title: Snap shut
clips.description: Flipped open, then dropped: the lid bangs shut and bounces.

clips.title: Peek twice
clips.description: The lid is lifted a crack twice, the second time a little more.

clips.title: Drop open, lift shut
clips.description: Released, the door drops open onto its stop and bounces; later it is lifted shut.

clips.title: Open and close
clips.description: The door folds down, waits, and folds up again.

clips.title: Flap rattle
clips.description: The door flaps a few times as letters are pushed in, then opens to take them out.

clips.title: Drop and winch up
clips.description: The trap falls open, swings like a pendulum about hanging straight down, then is winched closed at constant speed.

clips.title: Snap open
clips.description: Snaps open to hanging, waits, and closes with an ease.

clips.title: Test wiggle
clips.description: The trap is tested with small quick openings, then dropped open briefly.

clips.title: Driver's door
clips.description: The left door opens, waits, and closes.

clips.title: Both doors
clips.description: Both doors open together and close.

clips.title: Slam both
clips.description: Doors open one after the other, then both slam shut with a bounce.

clips.title: Lift and close
clips.description: The roof hatch lifts at the front, waits, and closes.

clips.title: Gas strut
clips.description: Pops up past its open position and settles back, like a gas strut; closes slowly.

clips.title: Slam
clips.description: Lifted, then dropped shut with a bounce.

clips.title: Flip open
clips.description: The canopy flips up past its open angle and settles, then closes.

clips.title: Slow seal
clips.description: Opens and closes slowly with cubic easing (a motorised seal).

clips.title: Emergency pop
clips.description: Pops open fast, waits, and lowers at a constant speed.

clips.title: Raise and lower
clips.description: Forks rise to the top, wait, and come down (the spring compresses and extends with them).

clips.title: Stepped hoist
clips.description: Forks rise in five equal steps with pauses, then come down smoothly.

clips.title: Drop
clips.description: Forks are raised high, then released: they drop and bounce on the bottom stop.

clips.title: Slide open and closed
clips.description: The door slides fully open along its rails, waits, and closes.

clips.title: Shove
clips.description: Shoved open, it runs into the end stop and bounces; shoved shut the same way.

clips.title: Crack open
clips.description: Slides open a little, waits, opens a bit more, then closes.

clips.title: Constant spin
clips.description: Two full turns at constant speed (loops seamlessly).

clips.title: Spin up and down
clips.description: Speeds up, cruises and slows down to stop after three turns.

clips.title: Sweep scan
clips.description: Scans back and forth over 120 deg, three times.

clips.title: Slew sweep
clips.description: With the boom slightly raised, the crane turns a quarter left, a quarter right and back.

clips.title: Luff up and down
clips.description: The boom rises and lowers; the hook stays plumb.

clips.title: Pick and place
clips.description: Boom up, slew a quarter turn, down to place the load, up, slew back and park.

clips.title: Tip and return
clips.description: The bucket tips up, waits for the load to slide out, and comes down.

clips.title: Hydraulic steps
clips.description: Tips in four stages with pauses, then lowers smoothly.

clips.title: Shake to empty
clips.description: Tips up, shakes quickly to free the load, and lowers.

clips.title: Raise and lower
clips.description: The boom rises to vertical, waits, and lowers.

clips.title: Drop onto the rest
clips.description: Snaps up, waits, then drops onto its rest and bounces.

clips.title: Quick up, slow down
clips.description: Rises fast and comes down slowly at constant speed.

clips.title: Winch up, drop down
clips.description: The bridge is winched up at constant speed, held, then let go: it falls onto the far bank and bounces.

clips.title: Raise and lower
clips.description: The bridge rises and lowers smoothly.

clips.title: Half raise
clips.description: Raised halfway twice, as if checking the chains.

clips.title: Toggle
clips.description: Each stick is snapped forward or back, held, and snapped home with a small bounce.

clips.title: Throttle
clips.description: Both sticks are pushed slowly forward at constant speed, held, and eased back.

clips.title: Jiggle
clips.description: Both sticks are jiggled quickly, out of step.
